caption: Fig. X. Monolithic PPO learning progression and formal comparison. (a) Deterministic capability probes at curriculum levels 2–4 at 0.35 m/s; policy updates are disabled during probing. The Adaptive marker shows its matched 24.576M interaction budget. (b) Strict task success on the same held out Stage 4 evaluation layout as Table I across target speeds for Mono checkpoints trained with 24.576M, 49.152M, and 61.440M interactions, together with Adaptive. The 0.60 m/s condition is 20% above the training speed range. Mono curves summarize one training seed; error bars are sample SD across three deterministic evaluation seeds. Mono and Adaptive use independent evaluation seed sets and are not episode-paired comparisons.
